calls.head: The Penguins should drive the play
calls.body: The Penguins have been near the top of the league at controlling the chances at 5-on-5, and the Sharks one of the worst. Expect the Penguins to spend more of the night in the Sharks’ end. That’s about the puck, not the scoreboard: goalies and finishing decide plenty of games the chances don’t.

calls.head: Crash the net vs. Bombs away
calls.body: On shots from in close, Pittsburgh is the league’s best, but San Jose is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Penguins to do more of their damage around the net.

SJS.head: We had San Jose as slight underdogs (42%), and it went Pittsburgh’s way.

PIT.head: We leaned Pittsburgh’s way (58%), and they came through.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Kindel wins it in a shootout
paras: Samuel Girard opened the scoring for the Penguins midway through the first. San Jose had a goal taken off after a video review midway through the second. Ben Kindel made it 2-0 for the Pens on the power play early in the third, but Macklin Celebrini pulled the Sharks within one midway through the period. Mason Marchment scored his 100th NHL goal with a little over four minutes left to tie it 2-2. Kindel scored the only goal of the shootout for the Penguins.

Nothing much separated these two on the chances. This one could have gone either way. The Sharks hit a post and the crossbar and still lost. Sergei Murashov made 34 saves for the Penguins, and Yaroslav Askarov kept the Sharks in it, stopping 33 of 35.

The Penguins killed all five Sharks power plays. The Penguins improved to 7-10-2 and climbed off the bottom of the Metropolitan to sixth, while the Sharks dropped to 8-11-2 but climbed to fifth in the Pacific.

items.text: The Sharks have won two of their last ten.
